title: AccountStore + PatAuthProvider + ZohoCorp Block
description: Implement the full account persistence layer and PAT authentication provider, including the ZohoCorp domain hard-block enforced at both storage and dispatch layers. This is the security-critical core that all higher-level commands depend on.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1 and 2 complete. Project compiles. IKeychainProvider, IOutputWriter, CliqCliException, ErrorCodes all exist.
goal: Produce a working AccountStore that persists AccountEntry records to accounts.json with correct permissions, and a PatAuthProvider that stores/retrieves PATs via IKeychainProvider while unconditionally blocking ZohoCorp-domain accounts.
scope: Create src/CliqCli.Core/Accounts/AccountEntry.cs as a sealed record with all properties: Name, Domain, Email?, Scopes, TokenType, IsDefault, NeedsReauth
Create src/CliqCli.Core/Accounts/AccountsRoot.cs as a sealed record with List<AccountEntry> Accounts
Create src/CliqCli.Core/Accounts/IAccountStore.cs with LoadAsync, SaveAsync, FindAsync, GetDefaultAsync

Create src/CliqCli.Core/Accounts/AccountStore.cs implementing IAccountStore — reads/writes accounts.json at <configDir>/accounts.json using System.Text.Json with SnakeCaseLower; applies 0600 permissions on Unix via File.SetUnixFileMode; Windows NTFS ACL restriction via FileSecurity (see OQ-004)

Create ZohoCorp domain check helper in CliqCli.Core as internal static class ZohoCorpGuard with static void AssertNotZohoCorp(string? email) — throws CliqCliException(ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED, 1) if email's first DNS label equals 'zohocorp' (case-insensitive)
Create src/CliqCli.Core/Auth/IAuthProvider.cs with GetTokenAsync, StoreTokenAsync, ClearTokenAsync

Create src/CliqCli.Core/Auth/PatAuthProvider.cs implementing IAuthProvider: StoreTokenAsync calls ZohoCorpGuard.AssertNotZohoCorp(email) BEFORE calling IKeychainProvider.SetAsync; GetTokenAsync reads from keychain; ClearTokenAsync deletes from keychain. Key format: 'cliq-cli:<accountName>:pat'
Register IAccountStore (AccountStore) and IAuthProvider (PatAuthProvider) as singletons in Program.cs DI

Write unit tests: AccountStore round-trip (write/read/verify); PatAuthProvider rejects zohocorp.com email with ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED; PatAuthProvider rejects zohocorp.eu; PatAuthProvider accepts personal@example.com
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
AccountStore.SaveAsync writes accounts.json with 0600 permissions on macOS/Linux
AccountStore.SaveAsync applies NTFS ACL restriction on Windows (current user only)
AccountStore round-trip: save an AccountEntry, load it back, fields match exactly
Token value is never serialized into accounts.json (verified by inspecting AccountEntry — no Token property present)
PatAuthProvider.StoreTokenAsync with email 'user@zohocorp.com' throws CliqCliException with code ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED
PatAuthProvider.StoreTokenAsync with email 'user@zohocorp.eu' throws CliqCliException with code ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED
PatAuthProvider.StoreTokenAsync with email 'user@zohocorp.com.au' throws CliqCliException with code ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED
ZohoCorpGuard is in CliqCli.Core, is internal, and has no conditional/runtime override path
contextForAgent: This story is security-critical. Read ADR-0006 thoroughly — the ZohoCorp check must run inside PatAuthProvider.StoreTokenAsync (before keychain write) AND inside ApiClient.CallAsync (story 5). ZohoCorpGuard must be a sealed, internal static class in CliqCli.Core — not in CliqCli, not in Keychain. The detection rule is: email.Split('@')[1].Split('.')[0].Equals('zohocorp', StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase). Read ADR-0003 for keychain key format. Read tech_spec §5 for AccountEntry shape. For Windows ACL, see OQ-004 default assumption. accounts.json uses snake_case via JsonNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower.

openItems.defaultAssumption: Use Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.ApplicationData) on macOS/Linux. Use Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData) on Windows. Append 'cliq-cli' to get the config base dir. Create the directory if it does not exist (Directory.CreateDirectory is idempotent).
See OQ-004. Use System.Security.AccessControl.FileSecurity. If ACL operation fails, log warning but do not fail the Save operation.
Throw CliqCliException with code NO_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT and exit 1.
